name: pylon
description: Connect Pylon to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Pylon MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Pylon to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with customer support issues using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Pylon workspace.
Find anything in Pylon that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review customer support issues in Pylon.
